purpose: Prove that a Minion Brief snapshot summarizes the queue as a PROJECTION over work-items+receipts, never the source of truth, and never silently rewritten: an original Brief is generated from the epic-2 queue state referencing real CWI-*/CR-* ids from the sibling slices, a subsequent queue change (source drift flagging a Work Item for review, plus a supersession) leaves the original Brief byte-stable, and a NEW refreshed Brief references the change. Brief creation is receipt-backed (manifest verb reviewed); all live mutations stay receipt-gated to Epic 2 and no live tenant write occurs in this slice.
